name: @sparx/social-worker
description: sparx social-worker. Receives social.post.due events via Pub/Sub push (Cloud Run HTTP entrypoint) and publishes each due post's targets to their platforms (Google Business Profile, …) via @sparx/social adapters. Resolves + refreshes the per-tenant OAuth grant, renders per platform, records each per-target result, and publishes social.post.published / social.post.failed. No-ops safely when the token key is unset.
